broader_reader_origin_route.H: Complete actual newly executed work; may depend on N, sampler count and bounded metadata size. No established value or upper bound.

domain_witnesses.reason: Every successful rational cell fallback executes upper midpoint exact division; unchanged counter after successful rows implies integer path <=1024-bit fields, giving <=2048-bit pair prospective bounds.
domain_witnesses.cost_status: unclosed; counter/native storage scan and all snapshot/readback actions must be counted
